column3: Just you wait, I'll still be Champion one day, so enjoy your title while it lasts!
HEATHER: You get so fiery about a good battle, Shelly.
So much that I think you're forgetting something.
SHELLY: I am?
Ah, I know what you mean--
Don't worry, I remembered very well.
I was just building up for the dramatic effect!
Speaking of, if I may make a strange request of you both.
Can you close your eyes and follow Heather and I?
We have one last surprise before sending you home.
TAKA: Well...
I mean, I don't mind.
This has been such a good party, I'm sure the surprise will be great...
SHELLY: Brilliant, just brilliant.
SHELLY: All right, now follow me...
SHELLY: Nearly there...
HEATHER: Okay, you two open your eyes!
ELIAS: I enjoyed it greatly.
Seeing that Reborn's future is so very bright...
It was truly inspiring, Champion of the Future.
And my Lord and I shall endeavor to make our future just as bright as this.
ELIAS: An odd request, but you have given us no reason to distrust you.
Any surprise to end such a pleasant occasion will surely be lovely, after all.
HEATHER: We figured if you have to go back, we should make sure you have something to remember this by!
SHELLY: With that in mind...
Everybody say "Reborn!"
EVERYBODY: Reborn!!!
SHELLY: \PN, sometimes if you want a memory immortalized forever...
All you need to do is wish upon a shooting star.
Now...
SHELLY: All right, this is it; time for Celebi to take you home.
Have a safe journey back.
SHELLY: Oh, and \PN?
Even if you'll be there to defend it in your timeline...
SHELLY: Watch your back-- I'm coming for your title!
HEATHER: \PN, hello again.
Are you enjoying the festivities?
Shelly truly is a wonderful champion, able to bring everyone together so quickly.
...I'm glad she was right that you'd come back.
She was very confident she was right, and I was confident in her.
But I doubt she'd have taken it well if she'd been wrong.
...But anyway, we already spoke back at the League.
Go and enjoy the party, talk to everyone else!
Shelly and I aren't going anywhere, we'll be here when you're done.
